events.title: England keep up their 100% record in the European Championship qualifiers with a 2–0 win over Northern Ireland at Windsor Park in their third qualifying game.
The former 애스턴 빌라 and Wales midfielder Trevor Hockey dies of a heart attack at the age of 43 after collapsing during a charity football match in West Yorkshire .

First Division strugglers 애스턴 빌라 and 맨체스터 시티 draw 0–0 at Villa Park. Newcastl United beat 레스터 시티 2–0 at home. A seven-goal thriller at Selhurst Park sees 찰턴 애슬레틱 beat 왓퍼드 4–3 to boost their survival bid. 토트넘 홋스퍼 keep their title hopes alive with a 3–0 home win over 노리치 시티. 에버턴 go top of the league with a 2–1 win at 첼시. Peter Davenport scores twice in a 3–2 home win for 맨체스터 유나이티드 over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. 더비 카운티 return to the top of the Second Division with a 2–0 win over 입스위치 타운 at Portman Road , while 포츠머스 drop down to second with a 1–0 defeat at 브래드퍼드 시티.

아스널 win the League Cup, beating 리버풀 2–1 in the final at Wembley. Charlie Nicholas scores both of 아스널's goals, which gives them their first League Cup triumph ever and their first major trophy for eight years. 이언 러시 scores on the losing side for the first time in his 리버풀 career.
In the only league action of the day, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 beat 왓퍼드 3–0 at Vicarage Road.
A midweek London derby sees 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 첼시 draw 0–0 at Selhurst Park. 토트넘 홋스퍼 remain in the hunt for the title with a 1–0 away win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 사우샘프턴 and 윔블던 draw 2–2 at The Dell.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 climb out of the bottom four with a 4–1 home win over 노리치 시티. 아스널's title hopes are virtually ended when they are beaten 3–1 by 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park. Second Division leaders 더비 카운티 moved closer to ending their seven-year exile from the First Division by beating 허더즈필드 타운 2–0 at the Baseball Ground .
Fourth Division side Halifax Town become the first Football League members to be run by their local council as part of a rescue package to save the club from bankruptcy.

토트넘 홋스퍼 reach their eighth FA Cup final by beating 왓퍼드 4–1 in the Villa Park semi-final. 찰턴 애슬레틱's survival chances are hit by a 2–1 defeat to 아스널 at Highbury. 에버턴 remain in pole position in the title race by beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 4–0 at Goodison Park . 맨체스터 시티's survival hopes are hit hard when they lose 4–2 at home to 사우샘프턴. A similar blow befalls 리버풀's title hopes as they lose 2–1 to 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road . 더비 카운티 remain top of the Second Division despite drawing 0–0 at home to local rivals 스토크 시티, although 포츠머스 are a point behind with a game in hand.
코번트리 시티 reach their first cup final by beating 리즈 유나이티드 3–2 at Hillsborough in the semi-final of the FA Cup. In the Second Division, a Midlands derby at St Andrew's sees 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat 버밍엄 시티 1–0.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 take another step towards First Division survival with a 1–0 win over 아스널 at Highbury. 노팅엄 포리스트 go sixth with a 3–2 away win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 왓퍼드 climb into the top half of the table by beating 첼시 3–1 at Vicarage Road . 웨스트햄 유나이티드's clash with 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Upton Park ends in a goalless draw.
토트넘 홋스퍼's title hopes are left hanging by a thread after they are held to a 1–1 draw by 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road, while the lost two points are a major blow to the hosts in their battle for survival.
Lawrie McMenemy resigns as manager of Second Division strugglers 선덜랜드, and is succeeded by Bob Stokoe , who was manager at 선덜랜드 when they won the FA Cup in 1973.

에버턴 move closer to winning the First Division title with a 1–0 away win over 애스턴 빌라, who are six points adrift of the relegation playoff place and seven points adrift of automatic survival with five games remaining. 리버풀 keep up their title bid with a 3–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트, as do 토트넘 홋스퍼 with a 1–0 home win over 찰턴 애슬레틱. 루턴 타운's excellent season continues with a 2–0 home win over 코번트리 시티 keeping them in fourth place. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 move closer to survival with a 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. 레스터 시티 keep clear of the bottom four with a 1–0 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 포츠머스 go top of the Second Division on goal difference ahead of 더비 카운티, who have a game in hand, by drawing 2–2 with Reading at Elm Park .

Without kicking a ball, 에버턴 took a huge step towards the league title as their last realistic title rivals 리버풀 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 were both beaten. 토트넘 홋스퍼 lost 2–1 to London rivals 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park, and 리버풀 went down 1–0 to a Peter Davenport goal for 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford. A relegation crunch game at Selhurst Park saw 찰턴 애슬레틱 boost their survival hopes by winning 3–0 against 애스턴 빌라, whose survival hopes were left hanging by a thread. Things were looking even more grim for 맨체스터 시티, who lost 3–2 at 셰필드 웬즈데이 and needed at least eight points from their last four games to stand any chance of survival.

A major twist occurs at both ends of the First Division, with victories for 리버풀 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 keeping their title hopes alive, while comprehensive victories for the bottom two of 애스턴 빌라 and 맨체스터 시티 keeps the survival hopes of both clubs alive. 더비 카운티 beat 셰필드 유나이티드 1–0 at Bramall Lane and now need just one point to secure automatic promotion, as do 포츠머스 after a 2–0 win over 그림즈비 타운 at Blundell Park .
England under-21s suffer a major blow to their European Championship qualification hopes when they draw 0–0 with Turkey in İzmir .
England's 100% record in the European Championship qualifiers ends in the fourth game when they can only manage a goalless draw with Turkey in İzmir.

Scarborough seal the Conference title to become the first team to win automatic promotion to the Football League following last summer's abolition of the re-election system. In the First Division, 에버턴 hold three-point lead over 리버풀 with a game in hand, and are eight points clear of third-placed 토트넘 홋스퍼. 더비 카운티 have overhauled 포츠머스 at the top of the Second Division, while 올덤 애슬레틱 are the only other team still able to achieve automatic promotion.
